$comment: The tunnel kit's set pieces (Tileset 04, Tunnel Systems: docs/map-briefs/tunnels/PLAN_2026-11-13.md). A single tunnel module carries a glowing fixture and no light; a lit run is the modules with a real light under each fixture (counted against the map's lights). Place it like the modules: under a hill, or a level down under flat ground, a portal on each end. Parts as in carriageway.json; parts are only ever added at the end. Edit, then run `node tools/content/setpieces.mjs`.

pieces.blurb: Three concrete tunnel modules in a row, north–south (24 m), a real light at each strip fixture: 3 lights. Buried like the modules; put a portal on each end.
